faq.question: What is in the GLOW blend?
faq.answer: BPC-157 10 mg, TB-500 10 mg and GHK-Cu 50 mg per vial (70 mg total), 10 vials per kit, price-list code GLOW70.

faq.question: Does the copper content affect handling?
faq.answer: The GHK-Cu component carries copper, so the blend has a blue-violet tint. Reconstitute according to your protocol and protect from light; the copper content is documented per component batch.

faq.question: Is a component COA included for each peptide?
faq.answer: Yes — analytical documentation covers each of the three peptides in the blend.

faq.question: Can the ratios be customised?
faq.answer: Yes, as an OEM configuration; MOQ and lead time are confirmed at quotation.
